description: Use this when the person asks about the tide at a spot. Not for waves or wind: use get_surf_forecast. Answers a spot's high and low tides for the coming days (at most 14) in its own time zone, with heights, worked out from the tide constants of the nearest station; says so where there is none.

spot.description: a surf spot's id as search_surf_spots or list_surf_spots_near show it, or its name (Ericeira, Supertubos, Hossegor)

name: get_tide_times
title: Get tide times
